items.text_vn: Tài khoản cũ có rất nhiều đồ rồi, giờ thấy đồ mới nên quay lại tải về chơi thì tài khoản cũ mất luôn, dù đã liên kết với Facebook rồi vẫn mất. Tiếc đồ cũ lắm. Làm ơn trả lại tài khoản cũ, không thì cho quay lại như cũ luôn đi, vì đã nạp (?) nhiều lắm rồi. Tệ thật sự.
items.summary_vn: Quay lại thì mất tài khoản cũ dù đã liên kết Facebook, đòi lấy lại.
items.text_en: My old account had tons of items. I saw new items so I came back and downloaded it, and my old account is gone, even though it was linked to Facebook. I really miss my old items. Please give my old account back, or just put things back the way they were, because I've topped up (?) a lot. Really bad.
items.summary_en: Returning player lost old account despite Facebook link; wants it back.

items.text_th:
แย่กว่าเดิม. โดนบังคับให้ย้าย Server เป็นของ VNG เทียบกับของเดิมแย่ลงเยอะมาก ใส่ Coupon code ยากมาก ต้องไปก๊อป ID ในเกมก่อน ถึงจะใส่ Coupon ได้

ไอดีที่ login ผ่าน Gmail ต้องกด login ใหม่ทุกครั้งที่เข้าเล่น เสียเวลามาก

ไอดีอื่นที่ login ผ่าน Facebook ถ้าแอพมีการเด้งตอนจะเข้าเกม ไม่ว่าจะด้วยสาเหตุอินเตอร์เน็ตไม่ดี หรืออะไรก็แล้วแต่ พอจะเข้าใหม่ ต้อง log in ใหม่ ซึ่งกรณีที่ Facebook เป็นคนละ account ที่ใช้ login ในเกม ต้องไปสลับบัญชี Facebook โคตรยุ่งยาก และเสียเวลา

สมัยของ Haegin เดิม ไม่เคยต้องทำอะไรแบบนี้
items.text_vn:
Tệ hơn trước. Bị bắt chuyển sang server VNG, so với bản cũ thì tệ đi nhiều. Nhập coupon code rất khó, phải đi copy ID trong game trước mới nhập coupon được.

Tài khoản đăng nhập qua Gmail phải bấm đăng nhập lại mỗi lần vào chơi, rất mất thời gian.

Tài khoản khác đăng nhập qua Facebook, nếu app bị văng lúc vào game, dù do mạng yếu hay lý do gì, thì khi vào lại phải đăng nhập lại. Trường hợp tài khoản Facebook khác với tài khoản dùng đăng nhập game thì phải đi đổi tài khoản Facebook, cực kỳ rắc rối và mất thời gian.

Thời Haegin trước đây chưa bao giờ phải làm mấy việc này.
items.theme: Lỗi đăng nhập đa thiết bị
items.summary_vn: Sau chuyển VNG, nhập code khó, phải đăng nhập lại liên tục.
items.text_en:
Worse than before. Forced onto the VNG server, it's much worse than the old version. Entering coupon codes is really hard, you have to copy your in-game ID first before you can enter a coupon.

Accounts that log in with Gmail have to tap log in again every time you play, a big waste of time.

For my other account that logs in with Facebook, if the app crashes while getting into the game, whether from weak internet or any other reason, I have to log in again when I come back. If the Facebook account is different from the one used for the game, I have to go switch Facebook accounts, super annoying and time-consuming.

Back in the Haegin days I never had to do any of this.
items.summary_en: After the VNG move, code entry is hard and constant re-logins are required.
